pages.title: Ramon Magsaysay Award — Educate Girls, first Indian organisation

facts.text: Recipient: Foundation to Educate Girls Globally (Educate Girls) — ⚠ first Indian organisation to win (source labels the award 2024)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Founded: 2007 by Safeena Husain
facts.head: News

facts.text: Works in: Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh; volunteers called "Team Balika"
facts.head: News

facts.text: Impact: 1.9 million+ girls back to school
facts.head: News

facts.text: Established: 1957 by Rockefeller Brothers Fund (USA) with Philippine government; first presented 1958
facts.head: Background — the award

facts.text: Named after: Ramon Magsaysay, 7th President of the Philippines (1953–1957); born 31 August 1907, Iba; died in air crash 17 March 1957
facts.head: Background — the award

facts.text: Ceremony: 31 August in Manila — ⚠ not New Delhi
facts.head: Background — the award

facts.text: Called: "Nobel Prize of Asia"
facts.head: Background — the award

facts.head: Background — the award

facts.head: Background — the award

facts.text: Indian recipient: Ravish Kumar; Year: 2019
facts.head: Background — the award

facts.text: Canonised by: Pope Leo XIV at St. Peter's Square, Vatican — ⚠ Catholic Church's first millennial saint
facts.head: News

facts.text: Nickname: "God's Influencer" — built multilingual website cataloguing Eucharistic miracles
facts.head: News

facts.text: Born: 3 May 1991, London; raised in Milan; died of acute leukaemia at 15 (diagnosed October 2006); buried in Assisi
facts.head: News

facts.text: Also canonised: Pier Giorgio Frassati — Italian, died 1925 aged 24 of polio
facts.head: News
